# OpsWithJane

> OpsWithJane is the practice of Jane Kenda, a client onboarding systems specialist based in Nairobi, Kenya. She designs and builds client onboarding systems for marketing agency owners, working remotely with marketing agencies in the United States.

Jane builds everything that happens between a client saying yes and a team being ready to deliver: intake, contract, payment, welcome, asset and access collection, internal handover, status tracking and quiet-client follow-up. She builds inside the platform the agency already uses, and the agency owns the system and its documentation.

- Tools: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Dubsado, Airtable, Asana, ClickUp, Zapier, Make
- Best fit: marketing agencies of 1 to 15 people that still onboard new clients by hand
- Credentials: HubSpot CRM certified, BSc Mathematics (University of Nairobi), ALX Virtual Assistant Programme
- Contact: opswithjane@gmail.com

## Packages

One-time project prices in US dollars. Scope is agreed in writing before work starts. Third-party software fees are separate.

- Onboarding Audit & Blueprint, $150: a review of how clients are onboarded today, the gaps and delays ranked, and a written blueprint of the system to build.
- Client Onboarding System, $650: everything in the audit, plus intake, contract, payment and welcome automated, with internal handover to the agency's project tool.
- Advanced Onboarding Infrastructure, $1,500: everything in the Client Onboarding System, plus asset and access collection, status tracking, quiet-client follow-up and full documentation.

## Free tool

- [The Onboarding Leak Check](https://tally.so/r/rDaPAl): 8 questions, about 2 minutes, showing where an agency's client onboarding loses time, momentum and goodwill.
